recent_activity.summary: At the Wells Fargo 21st Annual Healthcare Conference, Halozyme CEO Helen Torley and CFO Darren Snellgrove disclosed that the company now expects its first two Hypercon-based clinical programs to begin dosing in H1 2027, with potential first commercial launches in the 2030-2031 timeframe. Company also described now having four SC delivery platforms in its portfolio (ENHANZE, an auto-injector platform, Hypercon, and Surf Bio). First concrete clinical timeline disclosed for Hypercon since the Elektrofi acquisition closed.
recent_activity.summary_ko: Wells Fargo 제21회 연례 헬스케어 콘퍼런스에서 Halozyme의 Helen Torley 대표와 Darren Snellgrove 최고재무책임자는 Hypercon 기반 첫 임상 프로그램 2건이 2027년 상반기(H1 2027)에 투약을 시작할 것으로 예상하며, 첫 상업 출시는 2030-2031년 시점이 될 수 있다고 밝혔다. 회사는 현재 포트폴리오에 피하 전달 플랫폼 4종(ENHANZE, 오토인젝터 플랫폼, Hypercon, Surf Bio)을 보유하고 있다고도 설명했다. Elektrofi 인수 종결 이후 Hypercon에 대해 처음으로 구체적인 임상 일정이 공개된 것이다.

recent_activity.summary: China's National Medical Products Administration (NMPA) approved the subcutaneous formulation of LEQEMBI (lecanemab) as an initiation treatment for mild cognitive impairment or mild dementia due to Alzheimer's disease, using the same 500 mg once-weekly regimen (two consecutive 250 mg injections) as the U.S. SC-AI/IQLIK launch logged 2026-08-24. The China BLA was accepted January 2026 and granted Priority Review; once-weekly SC administration demonstrated exposure equivalent to once-every-two-weeks IV dosing with similar clinical/biomarker benefits. Launch is planned within Eisai's FY2026 (ending March 31, 2027). This is a geographic-expansion event for the already-tracked technology, not a new concentration/formulation claim -- the 200 mg/mL SC vs. 100 mg/mL IV figure already on file is unchanged.
recent_activity.summary_ko: 중국 국가약품감독관리국(NMPA)이 알츠하이머병으로 인한 경도인지장애 또는 경도 치매의 도입 치료제로 LEQEMBI(레카네맙) 피하 제형을 승인했으며, 2026-08-24 기록한 미국 SC-AI/IQLIK 출시와 동일하게 주 1회 500 mg(250 mg 주사 2회 연속) 요법을 적용한다. 중국 BLA는 2026년 1월 접수되어 우선심사를 받았고, 주 1회 피하 투여가 2주 1회 정맥 투여와 동등한 노출을 보이며 임상·바이오마커 측면에서도 유사한 이익을 입증했다. 출시는 에자이의 2026 회계연도(2027년 3월 31일 종료) 내로 계획되어 있다. 이미 추적 중인 기술의 지역 확대 사안이며 새로운 농도·제형 주장이 아니다. 기록된 피하 200 mg/mL 대 정맥 100 mg/mL 수치는 변동이 없다.

recent_activity.summary: Alteogen entered an option and license agreement granting Novartis multiple options to obtain exclusive rights to develop and commercialize subcutaneous formulations of several Novartis biologics using ALT-B4 (berahyaluronidase alfa), powered by Alteogen's Hybrozyme(TM) platform. Total potential value up to $3.223B (~KRW 4.4165 trillion) across option-exercise fees, development/regulatory/commercial milestones, and net-sales royalties; a conditional contract subject to regulatory approvals and clinical/commercial success. This is Alteogen's fourth licensing deal disclosed in 2026 (after GSK/Tesaro, Biogen, and an undisclosed pharma company in August) and the 10th deal overall under the Hybrozyme platform -- the second-largest in company history by disclosed maximum value, behind only the AstraZeneca deal. Filed via DART (Korea Financial Supervisory Service disclosure system) same-day.

recent_activity.summary_ko: 알테오젠이 노바티스에 Hybrozyme(TM) 플랫폼 기반 ALT-B4(베라히알루로니다제 알파)를 이용해 노바티스의 복수 바이오의약품 피하 제형을 개발·상업화할 독점 권리를 확보할 수 있는 다수의 옵션을 부여하는 옵션·라이선스 계약을 체결했다. 옵션 행사료와 개발·허가·상업화 마일스톤, 순매출 로열티를 합쳐 총 규모는 최대 $3.223B(약 KRW 4.4165 trillion, 4조 4,165억 원)이며, 규제 승인과 임상·상업적 성공을 전제로 한 조건부 계약이다. 2026년 공개된 알테오젠의 네 번째 라이선스 계약(앞서 GSK/Tesaro, 바이오젠, 8월의 미공개 제약사)이자 Hybrozyme 플랫폼 기준 통산 10번째 계약으로, 공개된 최대 규모 기준으로는 AstraZeneca 계약에 이은 창사 이래 두 번째로 큰 건이다. 같은 날 DART(금융감독원 전자공시시스템)를 통해 공시되었다.

recent_activity.summary: In an on-the-record interview, InventageLab CEO Kim Ju-hee said the company has signed Material Transfer Agreements with multiple domestic companies for its IVL-BioFluidic subcutaneous-conversion platform and has begun actual antibody verification work using real development-stage material received from those partners. Moves the platform from disclosed concept (JPMorgan Healthcare Conference January 2026, BIO USA June 2026) toward active technical validation against real candidate molecules; partner identities and target concentrations for this specific verification round were not disclosed.

recent_activity.summary: Huons Lab registered domestic (Korea) and international (PCT) composition patents covering SC formulations of 11 antibody drugs (pembrolizumab, bevacizumab, obinutuzumab, ramucirumab, donanemab, isatuximab, durvalumab, dostarlimab, cetuximab, risankizumab, dupilumab) co-formulated with its proprietary HyDiffuse rHuPH20 platform. recent_activity.summary: Eisai and Biogen announced that LEQEMBI IQLIK (lecanemab-irmb) autoinjector is now commercially available in the U.S. for SC initiation therapy in early Alzheimer's disease: 500 mg given once weekly as two consecutive 250 mg/1.25 mL injections, each delivered in approximately 15 seconds. This follows FDA approval of the initiation-dose sBLA on 2026-07-13 (out-of-window for this run; context only) and is separate from the SC maintenance-dose formulation (360 mg/1.8 mL) approved in August 2025. SC formulation is 200 mg/mL vs. 100 mg/mL for the IV formulation. Patients may switch between IV and SC administration at any point in the treatment course. NEW ENTITY - first log of Eisai/Biogen lecanemab in this tracker; included as an external cross-indication (Alzheimer's, not oncology/immunology) benchmark for commercially-validated high-concentration mAb SC autoinjector delivery.
recent_activity.summary_ko: 에자이와 바이오젠은 LEQEMBI IQLIK(레카네맙-irmb) 오토인젝터가 초기 알츠하이머병의 피하 도입 요법용으로 미국에서 상업 판매를 시작했다고 발표했다. 주 1회 500 mg을 250 mg/1.25 mL 주사 2회 연속으로 투여하며 각 주사는 약 15초가 걸린다. 2026-07-13 도입 용량 sBLA의 FDA 승인(이번 실행의 조사 기간 밖, 맥락 제공용)에 뒤이은 것이며, 2025년 8월 승인된 피하 유지 용량 제형(360 mg/1.8 mL)과는 별개다. 피하 제형은 200 mg/mL로 정맥주사 제형 100 mg/mL 대비 2배 농도다. 환자는 치료 과정 중 언제든 정맥주사와 피하주사를 전환할 수 있다. 신규 항목 - 본 트래커에 에자이·바이오젠 레카네맙을 처음 기록한 건이며, 상업적으로 검증된 고농도 단클론항체 피하 오토인젝터 전달의 외부 교차 적응증(종양학·면역질환이 아닌 알츠하이머병) 벤치마크로 포함했다.

recent_activity.summary: China's Center for Drug Evaluation (CDE) approved initiation of a Phase III study (JSKN033-301) for JSKN033, described by Alphamab Oncology as a first-in-class high-concentration SC co-formulation of a HER2 bispecific ADC (JSKN003; DAR4; site-specific glycan conjugation of a topoisomerase I inhibitor) with envafolimab (PD-L1 inhibitor). Trial: open-label, randomized, controlled, multicenter study of JSKN033 monotherapy vs. physician's-choice chemotherapy in recurrent/metastatic cervical cancer after platinum-based chemo/immunotherapy, irrespective of HER2 expression status. Company states the co-formulation is administered 'in tens of seconds' and is independent of hyaluronidase. No numeric concentration (mg/mL) disclosed in available coverage.

recent_activity.summary: Pathos AI licensed JSKN016 (a first-in-class TROP2/HER3 bispecific ADC) from Alphamab Oncology, gaining exclusive development/commercialization rights outside Greater China (Alphamab retains Chinese-territory rights). Terms: $125M non-refundable upfront + up to $2,093M in development/commercialization milestones + tiered royalties (high-single to low-double-digit % of net sales). Both IV and SC formulations of JSKN016 are covered; an SC formulation of JSKN016 is already in Phase Ib (China) and Phase I (Australia) trials. CAVEAT (per soul-file 'never guess' rule): the primary source does not explicitly confirm whether Alphamab's proprietary SC high-concentration platform IP itself transfers under this deal, or only rights to the JSKN016 molecule/its existing SC-formulated clinical material -- logged with this ambiguity flagged rather than assumed.

JSKN016의 정맥주사 제형과 피하 제형이 모두 포함되며, 피하 제형은 이미 1b상(중국)과 1상(호주)이 진행 중이다. 유의 사항(soul-file의 '추측 금지' 원칙에 따름): 1차 출처는 Alphamab의 독자 고농도 피하 플랫폼 지식재산 자체가 이 계약으로 이전되는지, 아니면 JSKN016 물질과 기존 피하 제형 임상 물질에 대한 권리만 이전되는지 명시하지 않으며, 추정하지 않고 이 모호성을 표시한 채 기록한다.

recent_activity.summary: G2G Bio and Celltrion signed an MOU including a Material Transfer Agreement (MTA) for 'ultra-high-concentration antibody SC formulation platform technology cooperation.' Under the MTA, Celltrion will transfer antibody substance(s) to G2G Bio so the companies can evaluate applicability to G2G Bio's high-concentration microparticle platform 'InnoBioLAMP' (an extension of G2G Bio's existing InnoLAMP long-acting microsphere DDS technology into biologics/antibodies), with a view to joint R&D and potential commercialization if feasibility is confirmed. This is G2G Bio's first public disclosure of InnoBioLAMP and marks its formal entry into antibody biologics. Specific target molecule(s), research schedule, and cost-sharing terms not disclosed; actual SC-formulation conversion feasibility still to be confirmed via non-clinical/clinical testing per company statement.
